subject: Malik Willis and the new offense
current_answer: Willis is the clear projected starter. Designed rushing is already visible, while passing results have varied with protection and receiver execution.
next_test: Record preseason dropbacks, designed runs, play action, pressure response, and target distribution.

subject: De'Von Achane workload
current_answer: Achane is the clear RB1 and remains involved as a runner, receiver, and red-zone target. The backfield split and goal-line allocation are not established.
next_test: Chart preseason snaps, routes, targets, carries inside the 10, two-minute work, and Willis goal-line keepers.

subject: Receiver pecking order
current_answer: Malik Washington has been the most consistent early receiver and is the best current anchor. Tolbert and Atwell project with him; Douglas has flashed, while Bell remains unavailable. Exact alignment and route shares are unresolved.
next_test: Chart the first preseason game's 11-personnel starters, routes, slot/boundary alignments, third-down work, and returns.

subject: Kadyn Proctor position and starting line
current_answer: Proctor has settled at left guard. The projected line is Patrick Paul, Proctor, Aaron Brewer, Jonah Savaiinaea, and Austin Jackson; Jackson's day-to-day injury makes right-tackle depth the immediate uncertainty.
next_test: Confirm Jackson's return and identify the first replacement at right tackle in practice and the preseason opener.

subject: Chris Johnson immediate role
current_answer: Johnson is projected to start and is learning outside corner and nickel. His primary alignment, matchup assignments, and every-down share remain open.
next_test: Chart preseason outside/nickel snaps, coverage technique, and whether he stays on the field in base and subpackages.

subject: Edge rotation behind Chop Robinson
current_answer: Robinson is the clear lead edge. Uche has the best early evidence for the complementary pass-rush role, with Ferrell, Goode, Moore, Ojabo, and others still competing by situation.
next_test: Chart preseason early-down, third-down, and two-minute edge combinations plus pressures by alignment.

subject: Safety and nickel competitions
current_answer: Dante Trader projects at one safety spot. Lonnie Johnson remains a projected starter but is day-to-day; Zayne Anderson has two reported interceptions and is pressing the competition. Nickel remains unsettled among Jason Marshall and cross-trained Chris Johnson.
next_test: Chart preseason base/subpackage alignments, deep/box responsibility, slot snaps, and special-teams participation.

subject: Bobby Slowik personnel and play calling
current_answer: Camp includes extensive 11-on-11 work and has shown designed Willis keepers. Reporting restrictions and the lack of preseason snaps leave personnel groupings, motion, pass rate, and play-action frequency unresolved.
next_test: Chart the preseason opener by personnel, motion, play action, launch point, early-down call, and quarterback design.

subject: Kicker competition
current_answer: Patterson and Gonzalez both converted the available reported situational kicks; no leader is established.
next_test: Log every reported attempt by distance and hash plus kickoffs and game-pressure opportunities.

subject: Thirteen-rookie roster influence
current_answer: Proctor and Chris Johnson project as immediate starters; Rodriguez, Douglas, Kacmarek, Moore, and others have relevant camp evidence. Bell remains on NFI and Konga is out for the season.
next_test: Record preseason snaps by phase, first-unit appearances, special-teams roles, health, and the first cutdown decisions.
